message: This is split child 1/4 and covers only the transport (realtime plus polling fallback, and the ThreadClient contract with idempotency keys). OVD-804 T-1 to T-8 and its Proof (WebKit Playwright run, iPhone recording, bundle-size diff) are not exercised here and must be verified on #838 and #839.

emit() marks a batch as seen before deliver() runs. If deliver throws during a poll, the error is handled as a poll failure and the same events are filtered out on the next poll, so they are never delivered (probe P10).

Broadcast payloads are passed through without validation: an undefined payload throws a TypeError inside the realtime callback, and a partial object is delivered as a GraphEvent (probe P9). The code says server-side validation is intended; the shell should still guard before render.
The dedupe set grows for the life of a listen() with no bound. That is fine for one conversation but worth capping if a thread stays mounted for long runs.
